common.curve: validation quality versus cumulative measured training CPU at the three fixed checkpoints
common.failure_policy: preserve failed jobs and unchanged retries; source corrections require new seal and separate study
common.optimizer: AdamW; matrix weights decay 0.0001; vectors and declared no-weight-decay parameters excluded
common.selection: minimum validation CE at quarter, half and final update; test scored once after reload
common.test_policy: no test-driven architecture or hyperparameter reselection
common.timing: all preparation/training/selection/serialization/reload/test charged separately; CPU is not Joules

limits: No natural synchronized audio-video corpus; image/audio pairs and four-token queries form a constructed benchmark.
Two heldout FSDD speakers do not establish broad speaker-population generalization.
Mamba is an equation-verified CPU reference, not fused CUDA performance.
The diffusion scale is task-trained, not independently calibrated uncertainty.
Task-value stopping is distinct from the cell natural firing threshold.
The cell uses frozen-interval FPT and mean-field recurrent propagation with interval-end reset.
Finite CPU scaling experiments are not foundation-model scaling-law evidence.

mechanism.uncertainty: paired training seeds; fixed heldout sources; four comparisons per task; 98.75 percent Bonferroni intervals

representation.scope: same frontend, readout, seed, minibatches and optimizer recipe; equal width is not equal parameter count or compute

scaling.scope: capacity/data/context axes separated; multimodal joint length is null-step stress, long_memory length adds genuine distractors
